The executable follows the normative §4 formula.  Pop 4 is never reached (G1), so the p4 table entry cannot change any N or guard used here; recorded explicitly rather than silently repaired.

limitations.explanation: The task caps this executable's horizon at <=27 (h<=27).  The current v2.1 contract/fixture uses H=34 and an O6b horizonOk obligation.  Baseline/cost-110 N=20/25 and every one of the 128 theta minima are below 27, so minimality searches are unaffected; the H=34 guard/sensitivity envelope is NOT checked here.

The contract writes both 'legal s a <-> a in allActions s' (O2) and 'legal := step.isSome' (O2b).  This executable exposes the literal powerset box (pop1/2/3: 50/110/150), the structural filter (5/50/62), and the step-viable set.  A Lean porter can take allActions := structural box and legal := step.isSome; starving tuples in that box then have step=none.
prod(extra) is totalised to 0 when extra=none (v2.1 extraGain).  Legality allows extra=none, so the old 'extra exists by legality' justification is not used.
